title: Assembly and Cryo-EM structure determination of yeast mitochondrial RNA polymerase initiation complex intermediates
protocol: Mix 10 μM each of respective template and non-template DNA oligonucleotides in standard 1× TE buffer with 50 mM NaCl.
Place the tubes containing the mixtures in a heating block set at 95°C for 10 min.
Switch off the heating block and allow it to cool to 25°C to promote annealing of the oligonucleotides.

Preincubate 2 μM yeast 21S rRNA promoter DNA fragment or pre-melted 15S initiation bubble promoter with y-mtRNAP (1 μM) and WT or mutant MTF1 (2 μM) in transcription initiation reaction buffer at 25°C.
Initiate RNA synthesis by adding 100 μM each of ATP, UTP, GTP, and 1.25 mM 3′-dCTP spiked with α-32P-GTP.
Terminate reactions after 15 min using 125 mM EDTA and formamide dye mixture (98% formamide, 0.025% bromophenol blue, 10 mM EDTA).
Resolve RNA products on a 24% polyacrylamide, 4 M urea gel.
Expose the gel image to a phosphor plate, scan, and analyze using ImageQuant to calculate molar runoff RNA products.
Synthesize yeast 21S rRNA promoter DNA fragment with 7-aminopurine (2AP) at position -4 in the non-template strand or -1 in the template strand.
Prepare samples of 2-aminopurine assay buffer alone.
Prepare a sample of -4 2AP DNA alone at a concentration of 200 nM.
Mix -4 2AP DNA with y-mtRNAP and MTF1 WT or mutants (each at 400 nM).
Measure fluorescence intensity in a FluoroMax spectrometer (excitation at 315 nm, emission at 380 nm) at 25°C.
Plot the intensity of each sample.
Label promoter DNA with 2AP at position -1 in the template strand.
Add increasing concentrations of initiating nucleotides (ATP+GTP) to a complex of -1 2AP promoter DNA (200 nM), y-mtRNAP (400 nM), and MTF1 WT or mutants (400 nM).
Measure fluorescence emission intensity at 380 nm after excitation at 315 nm.
Plot the titration data.
Estimate the cumulative Kd of initiating nucleotides by fitting to a hyperbolic equation Fc = Fm * [N] / (Kd + [N]).
Mix an equimolar complex of y-mtRNAP and MTF1 at 2 μM each in ultrafiltration assay buffer for a final volume of 500 μL.
Incubate the mixture at 25°C for 15 min.
Filter through a 100 kDa MW cut-off Microcon centrifugal filter unit at 2,000 × g until the first retentate volume is about 50 μL.
Dilute the retentate to 500 μL with buffer and filter again.
Repeat the washing step and take a sample after each wash.
Collect samples consisting of the initial protein complex, first retentate, filtrate, and retentate samples.
Analyze collected samples on a 4%–20% SDS-PAGE.
Incubate ΔN100 y-mtRNAP, MTF1, and promoter DNA in a molar ratio 1:1.2:1.2 for 2 h at 4°C to prepare the y-mtRNAP PmIC.
Purify the complex by size-exclusion chromatography using a Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL column mounted on a GE AKTA Pure 25 FPLC in-line with MALS, dRI, and DLS devices.
Concentrate the purified y-mtRNAP complex sample to 2.7 mg/mL in buffer A.
Aliquot the concentrated sample and store at -80°C without flash freezing.
Incubate y-mtRNAP PmIC, 2-mer RNA, and UTPαS at a molar ratio of 1:6:50 for 2 h on ice to form the transcription initiation complex (y-mtRNAP IC).
Add 8 μL of the y-mtRNAP IC or ymtRNAP PmIC complex at a concentration of ~0.5 mg/mL into a Wyatt disposable cuvette.
Place the sample cuvette in the sample chamber maintained at 4°C for Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS) experiments.
Acquire 30 readings for each sample using Dynamics software version 7.10.0.23.
Mix 5 μg of protein in a volume of 20 μL containing 1× buffer A and 1× Protein Thermal ShiftTM dye for thermal shift assay.
Ramp the temperature from 4°C to 95°C at a rate of 3°C/min during the thermal shift experiment.
Measure fluorescence from the dye at 623 ± 14 nm wavelength with an excitation wavelength of 580 ± 10 nm.
Analyze data using Protein Thermal Shift 1.3 software for thermal stability determination.
Prepare vitreous grids of y-mtRNAP IC on Quantifoil R 1.2/1.3 holey carbon grids using a Leica EM GP.
Glow-discharge the grids for 30 seconds at 10 mA current with the chamber pressure set at 0.30 mBar (PELCO easiGlow; Ted Pella).
Place the grids prior to glow-discharge over a filter paper soaked with chloroform for two hours.
Air dry the grids for 16 hours.
Mount the glow-discharged grids in the sample chamber of a Leica EM GP at 8°C and 95% relative humidity.
Blot the grids.
Plunge-freeze the grids in liquid ethane at temperature −172°C.
Spot 5 μL of sample at a concentration of 1 mg/mL in buffer A onto Quantifoil R 1.2/1.3 holey carbon grids.
Incubate the grid with the sample for 30 seconds.
Back blot the grid using two pieces of Whatman Grade 1 filter paper for 12-14 seconds.
Collect high-resolution datasets at ESRF-Grenoble CM01 facility using a 300 kV Titan KRIOS TEM equipped with a Gatan K2 Summit direct electron detector and a Gatan energy filter.
Automate data collection for y-mtRNAP PmIC using EPU version 2.5 (ThermoFisher).
Collect electron movies in counting mode at a nominal magnification of 165,000× with a total exposure time of 6 seconds and a dose of 65 e-/Å².
Record the movies as gain corrected MRC files.

Collect images for y-mtRNAP IC sample using EPU software version 2.6.1 (ThermoFisher) in counting mode at a nominal magnification of 165,000× with an exposure time of 5 seconds and a dose of 61 e-/Å².
Apply beam-image shift during data collection to increase data throughput.
Align all frames in individual movies using MotionCor2 as implemented in Scipion.
Perform contrast-transfer-function estimations using CTFFIND-4.
Pick 18,648 particles from a cryo-EM grid of y-mtRNAP IC using Xmipp picker.
Classify the picked particles into thirteen 2D classes using Relion 3.0.8.
Use the set of thirteen 2D classes as the template for picking particles from high-resolution y-mtRNAP PmIC and y-mtRNAP IC datasets with Autopick routine in Relion 3.0.8.
Re-align 1–48 out of 60 frames for y-mtRNAP PmIC using MotionCor2 implemented in Relion.
Re-align 1–42 out of 50 frames for y-mtRNAP IC using MotionCor2 implemented in Relion.
Re-extract the particles after re-alignment.
Fit CTF parameters and apply per-particle defocus correction using Relion 3.0.8.
Calculate the final map using Refine3D.
